page_title: MNT 1-1 STR | Montpellier v Strasbourg 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+12' The goalkeeper made a fine save to prevent Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) from converting his header after a dangerous cross. The ball went into the middle of the goal, where the goalkeeper was standing.
90+12' It seemed like Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+10' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
90+7' Karol Fila (Strasbourg) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Mathieu Vernice's book.
90+7' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Caleb Wiley.
90+1' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+1' The ball goes out of play. Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
90' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) will replace Arnaud Nordin.
86' Liam Rosenior has decided to make a change. Karol Fila (Strasbourg) replaces Ismael Doukoure.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
82' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) sees a yellow card from Mathieu Vernice after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nordine Kandil is coming onto the pitch as Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' The substitution has been made. Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) has replaced Akor Adams.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
76' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
73' The game is interrupted now, Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' The ball is behind the touchline and Montpellier will take a throw-in.
70' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
70' A rebound bounces out to Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
69' Strasbourg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
69' Dangerous play by Joris Chotard (Montpellier). Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
67' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Teji Savanier (Montpellier) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Karl-Johan Johnsson no chance!
66' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

65' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game. One of the players from Strasbourg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Montpellier.
62' A dangerous towering header by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
62' The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
58' 0 - 1 Goal! Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
57' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
55' Akor Adams (Montpellier) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Karl-Johan Johnsson is alert and denies him.
54' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
53' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) picks up a yellow card.
52' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
51' The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will take a throw-in.
49' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
49' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
47' The Strasbourg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Liam Rosenior probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg). He is replaced by Diego Moreira.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) is replaced by Marvin Senaya.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

44' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.

39' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) gets inside the box and tries to beat Karl-Johan Johnsson with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
37' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
37' It seemed like Teji Savanier (Montpellier) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
35' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
34' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

34' Akor Adams (Montpellier) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the right side of the goal. Karl-Johan Johnsson is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
33' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Karl-Johan Johnsson comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' A cross from a corner kick by Montpellier is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

32' Karl-Johan Johnsson makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Akor Adams (Montpellier) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play. Montpellier will have a chance to score from a corner.
30' A player from Strasbourg commits a rough challenge. Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
27' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mathieu Vernice didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
27' The Montpellier players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
24' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
23' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

22' Caleb Wiley (Strasbourg) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte keeps it out.
21' Mathieu Vernice shows the yellow card to Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) for a heavy challenge.
20' The ball has crossed the sideline. Strasbourg are taking a throw-in.
17' Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
17' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will take the corner.
16' The resulting corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Strasbourg.
14' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Emanuel Emegha, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
12' It looks like Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) saw red with that tackle. Mathieu Vernice won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
10' Montpellier are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
6' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner which is cleared.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mathieu Vernice.
